name: Community — P-H3-Image
author: michaeldune
description: P-H3-Image, Pruna's 8-step image model distilled from MiniMax H3: text to image at about 8 megapixels and editing with up to four pictures, through a built-in prompt writer. Runs on a 12 GB card. Uses the MiniMax H3 FL2VA int8 model the H3 video packs already download, plus about 17 GB of its own files. Needs SimpliGen's engine at ComfyUI v0.44.0 or newer. LICENCE: the P-H3-Image weights and the MiniMax H3 transformer are under the MiniMax H3 Community License.

presets.name: P-H3-Image
presets.tagline: 8-megapixel pictures in 8 steps from MiniMax H3
presets.description: Text to image with P-H3-Image, Pruna's 8-step image model distilled from MiniMax H3. Write a short request; a built-in prompt writer turns it into a full description first, so one line is enough. It renders at about 8 megapixels (3360x2496 at 4:3) in about a minute on a 12 GB card. LICENCE: the P-H3-Image weights and the MiniMax H3 transformer are under the MiniMax H3 Community License.

extensions.name: rgthree-comfy
extensions.description: Power Lora Loader, used by SimpliGen's own LoRA slot. Usually pre-installed.

requirements.notes: Weights: the MiniMax H3 FL2VA pruned int8 transformer (21.0 GB, shared with the H3 video packs) plus four files from PrunaAI/P-H3-Image-Comfy (commit 44a0fb7): the P-H3-Image LoRA (2.0 GB), the int8 text encoder (5.1 GB, a Qwen3-VL 4B with a connector), the int8 single-frame VAE (3.1 GB) and the w4a8 prompt upsampler (6.7 GB, Qwen3.5 9B). Needs ComfyUI v0.44.0 (Comfy-Org/ComfyUI#17506 and #17492). Sampling per the Comfy template: 8 steps on a fixed ManualSigmas grid, er_sde, no CFG, MiniMaxH3SigmaShift 1.0/1.0. Every prompt goes through the upsampler first, which writes the full brief the model renders; it is greedy but its wording can differ between installs, so the same seed may not give the same picture on another PC. Measured engine-direct on a 4070 Ti 12 GB (2026-11-04): VRAM peaked at 11.3 GB because the weights stream. Measured in SimpliGen 2026-11-04: text to image at 8 MP 59-62 s; a one-picture edit 67-68 s; a two-picture edit with an 8 MP reference 131 s. LICENCE: the P-H3-Image weights and the MiniMax H3 transformer are under the MiniMax H3 Community License (https://huggingface.co/PrunaAI/P-H3-Image-Comfy); check it before commercial use.

presets.name: P-H3-Image Edit
presets.tagline: Edit a picture by describing the change
presets.description: Edit a picture with P-H3-Image. Picture 1 is the one that changes; the result keeps its shape and comes out at about 4 megapixels. Pictures 2 to 4 are optional references; name them in the request as <Picture 2>, <Picture 3>, for example: Put the hat from <Picture 2> on the man. One short sentence works best. About a minute with one picture on a 12 GB card; big reference pictures add time (about two minutes with an 8-megapixel second picture). LICENCE: the P-H3-Image weights and the MiniMax H3 transformer are under the MiniMax H3 Community License.
